title: Server deploy window
description: Deploy for 2 hours, only overnight (20:00 to 06:00), when CPU load is under 60 and the job queue is at most 20; prefer the quietest hour. Data: cpu_load and queue_depth every hour for 3 days.

title: EV charging
description: Charge for 4 hours while plugged in (18:00 to 08:00), only when the grid is at most 300 g CO2/kWh; prefer the cheapest power. Data: electricity price and grid carbon intensity every hour for 2 days.

title: Bakery batch with a proofing wait
description: Mix for 1 hour (05:00 to 13:00, dry room), proof for 2 to 4 hours (not checked), then bake for 1 hour when the oven is free; prefer cheap power. Data: room humidity, an oven_free flag (1 or 0) and power price every hour for 2 days.
